## EMST role: Wildlife biologist (state variant, entry level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:broadMatch`, confidence 0.5, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R15-wildlife-biologist/state:2682`). *Authority position (editorial):* resource-manager.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Capture, handle and mark wildlife and fish humanely and safely — entry L1
- Detect and record wildlife by direct observation, sign and standardized surveys — entry L1
- Assess species habitat requirements and habitat condition — entry L1
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — entry L1
- Assess effects on protected species and conduct interagency consultation on proposed actions — entry L1
- Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results — entry L1
- Assess and monitor biodiversity across species and habitats — entry L1
- Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids — entry L1
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Capture animals with traps, nets or electrofishing following the approved animal-care protocol and permit conditions
- Immobilize an animal chemically where authorized, monitoring vital signs until recovery and recording drug doses
- Mark captured animals with tags or other marks while recording biological data within protocol handling-time and stress limits
- Apply zoonotic disease and personal safety precautions when handling wildlife, including protective equipment and decontamination
- Deploy camera traps and acoustic recorders at survey stations to the protocol's height, orientation and settings, recording station metadata
- Conduct ground or aerial counts of target species along defined survey units to support abundance estimation
- Conduct point-count, transect or call-playback wildlife surveys to protocol, recording detections, distance bands and survey conditions
- Measure habitat attributes such as cover, structure, water and forage at used and available sites following a habitat-use study protocol
- Observe animal movement, foraging and breeding behaviour at study sites, recording behaviour and habitat context on standardized forms
- Identify regional plants and animals to species with dichotomous keys and diagnostic features, collecting evidence for any record not identified with certainty
- Verify species records submitted by crews or volunteers against attached photos, recordings or vouchers before they enter the program database
- Compile species and habitat occurrence information for an action area, documenting the sources and survey dates used for each listed species

## EMST role: Fisheries and aquatic biologist (state variant, entry level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:broadMatch`, confidence 0.55, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R16-fisheries-aquatic-biologist/state:2682`). *Authority position (editorial):* resource-manager.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Manage fish populations and habitats to stated conservation and harvest objectives — entry L1
- Capture, handle and mark wildlife and fish humanely and safely — entry L1
- Operate small boats and work safely on water in aquatic, coastal and marine field settings — entry L1
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — entry L1
- Apply field biosecurity and decontamination protocols — entry L1
- Operate fish hatchery and aquatic propagation programmes — entry L1
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — entry L1
- Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results — entry L1
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Sample fish populations by electrofishing, netting or hydroacoustics following the survey protocol to estimate abundance and size structure
- Capture animals with traps, nets or electrofishing following the approved animal-care protocol and permit conditions
- Immobilize an animal chemically where authorized, monitoring vital signs until recovery and recording drug doses
- Mark captured animals with tags or other marks while recording biological data within protocol handling-time and stress limits
- Execute person-overboard, capsize and cold-water immersion procedures for a small-boat crew during drills and real events
- Work sampling gear such as grabs, nets, sondes or traps over the side of a small vessel, keeping crew clear of lines and winches
- Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
- Screen field measurement results against applicable water-quality criteria before leaving the site, triggering resampling or notification when an exceedance appears
- Adapt the decontamination procedure on site when a new pathogen or invasive organism is suspected, escalating the finding before moving on
- Decontaminate boots, gear, boats and vehicles between field sites with the protocol's method and contact time for the target organisms
- Sequence site visits from lower-risk to higher-risk waters or stands so that crews cannot carry organisms from infested to uninfested sites
- Spawn broodstock following the genetic management plan's mating scheme, recording parentage for each lot

## EMST role: Water and wastewater treatment operator (state variant, entry level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:relatedMatch`, confidence 0.2, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R25-water-wastewater-operator/state:2682`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulated-party.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Operate drinking water treatment processes to meet water quality targets — entry L1
- Operate wastewater treatment and resource-recovery processes to permit limits — entry L1
- Practice within licensure scope and responsible charge — entry L1
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1
- Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites — entry L1
- Protect operational technology at environmental utilities and facilities — entry L1
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — entry L1
- Manage a municipal stormwater programme to meet permit conditions — entry L1
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1
- Manage physical assets and capital plans with risk-based asset management — entry L1

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Adjust coagulant dosing from jar test results when raw-water turbidity, temperature or organic content changes
- Verify disinfection contact time against required inactivation values at each operating flow and correct shortfalls before water enters distribution
- Respond to a treatment upset by isolating the affected process unit, bringing backup treatment online and notifying the primacy agency
- Adjust aeration and sludge wasting rates using solids inventory, settleability and dissolved-oxygen trends to hold effluent within permit limits
- Diagnose a biological process upset from microscopic examination, foam, odor and settling behavior before laboratory results confirm it
- Route peak wet-weather flows through the plant to protect biological treatment, recording any bypass or overflow for required reporting
- Operate anaerobic digestion and solids handling to meet biosolids pathogen-reduction and stability requirements while recovering digester gas
- Monitor automated control loops and alarms on a treatment process, checking automated responses against field observations of process condition
- Override an automated control action when process indicators show it is driving the system toward a permit or safety limit, documenting the decision
- Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
- Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them
- Report field conditions that invalidate samples, such as broken seals, temperature excursions or holding-time breaches, before results are used

*Credential gates (issuer verified):* Drinking water treatment operator certification (Grades I-IV / Class A-D, state-specific) (required); Wastewater treatment operator certification (Grades I-IV) (required)
